Beats on the Bay has been a huge success this year, with giant flotillas of boaters out enjoying the music. The final edition is on Tuesday, Sept. 1 and features Henry Mansfield. Earlier this year he won a “battle of the bands” type competition for a slot on the big stage at the NW Tune-Up festival so it’s fair to say he’s having a big year. His music manages to blend epic pop hooks, emotional vulnerability and unpredictable storytelling and instrumentation. This should be an extra fun one. [...] ### Jazz Center of Bellingham Open House
